note: Exporter of dehydrated onion/garlic products (onion powder, toasted onion chopped, dehydrated garlic cloves, white onion powder) from Gujarat (registered address: Survey No 120/1, Bhanwadharipara Road, Dwarka-Adhish Marg), shipping via Pipavav and Mundra to Portugal, Canada, Germany, Poland. Declared HS 071290 is broadly consistent with actual records, but the observed codes are more specific: 07122000 (dried onions, whole/cut/sliced/powdered) dominates, with one 07129030 (dried garlic) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the factual code should be recorded as 07122000 (primary) / 07129030 (secondary). Export activity is factual, not merely declared: dated customs lines with B/L numbers 9681236, 9586634, 8926367, 8437509, 8409167. Note the buyer field is largely 'TO ORDER' (order/consignee-not-named), so end-buyer identity is not public; the counterparty list on the same page (e.g. Symrise Ltda, IFF Mexico, Hallesche Essig-und Senffabrik GmbH) is a portal aggregate and was not row-verified. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the free views. Domestic (India) supply: no traces found in the sources checked, but this is a coverage gap rather than a negative finding, hence 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'. Role: manufacturer (own dehydration plant implied by product range and Gujarat factory address), though no registry document was opened to confirm legal form/CIN — CIN and PAN: null, not verified.
